tools.name: search_companies
tools.title: Search companies
tools.description: Search companies by free-text query and/or country. Requires the companies:read scope.

query.description: Free-text terms, e.g. "AI companies". Every term must match a whole word in name, industry or description.

country.description: Exact country name, case-insensitive, e.g. Australia.

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Fetch one company by id. Requires the companies:read scope.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by companyId and/or jobTitle. Requires the contacts:read scope.

tools.name: enrich_contact
tools.title: Enrich contact
tools.description: Enrich one contact's email and LinkedIn via the synthetic mock provider. Requires the contacts:enrich scope. Results are synthetic fixtures, never verified real-world data.

tools.name: export_contacts
tools.title: Export contacts
tools.description: Export up to 200 contacts as a CSV download link, valid for 15 minutes. Requires the contacts:export scope.
